clips.title: The story
paras: Tarrel Rockweaver waits in the Wetlands for word from Merrin at the Whelgar Excavation Site. His wife has missed two weeks of letters, and he fears disaster at the eastern dig.

Tarrel Rockweaver has heard nothing from his wife, Merrin, for two weeks. From her post at the Whelgar Excavation Site, she used to send him weekly letters about the work. Now Tarrel fears calamity has struck the camp. With dwarf authorities stretched thin, he turns to passing scouts to learn whether the diggers are still alive.

The Whelgar Excavation Site lies east in the Wetlands, where dwarves dig for ancient Titan relics and history. Crews working in the wild can face beasts and threats from below. The site is far from the main roads, and whatever stopped the letters has left the diggers beyond easy reach.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You cannot imagine how worried I have been.

My wife, Merrin, has been sending me letters each week for the past month. She is part of the Whelgar Excavation team. But it has been nearly two weeks since her last correspondence. Surely something is wrong!
Longbraid said that he would send a scout to check up on things if we did not hear from the team soon. I assume that scout is you, friend. Find Merrin at the excavation site to the east!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, thank the heavens you are here!
